rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Go-based MCP server that provides AI assistants with comprehensive access to HTTP traffic captured by powhttp, a network analysis tool. Offers specialized tools for searching HTTP entries, analyzing TLS fingerprints, comparing browser vs programmatic requests for anti-bot detection, clustering API endpoints, tracing request flows, and validating response schemas against Go structs or Zod definitions. Built with roaring bitmaps for fast search and LRU caching for performance. Includes guided prompts for common workflows like building API maps from captured traffic and generating MVP scrapers.
